title: Chapter 1126
text:
The quality of this batch of items was way too shocking!

Han Xiao was not mentally prepared at all. He was stunned for a moment before ecstasy filled his heart.

Because the two of them were perfectly compatible with each other, they could draw any ability or talent. Thus, Manison's thousands of blueprints lowered the chances of him drawing something good.

Han Xiao's original goal was to draw a Molding Talent at most, but he did not expect to draw Manison's greatest treasure!

(Billion Mecha Empire — Manison), Unique Talent!

Look at this effect, it's definitely at the Molding Talent level! Furthermore, it's at the peak of the Molding Talent level!

This was definitely Manison's trump card!

The Unique Talents of normal people came from their own experiences, and they were extremely unique.

Usually, the talents formed after becoming stronger would be more powerful than the ones formed earlier. (Billion Mecha Empire) was clearly a talent formed after Manison became famous, and the conditions to form it were extremely harsh. It was the result of his hundreds of years of experience.

In other words, this talent was equivalent to the 'inner core' that old Manison had cultivated for many years, containing the essence of his life!

But now, the fruits of Old Man Manison's lifetime of cultivation were in his hands …

It was like fishing in the river, and in one fell swoop, he actually caught a protected animal!

The richness of the rewards completely exceeded Han Technician's expectations, and he was so excited that he wanted to eat a few more packs of nutrition paste.

I'm f * cking rich!

"Luck is indeed something that needs to be accumulated. The luck that Harrison has accumulated over the years is probably all gone because of me." Han Xiao was extremely excited.

Putting aside (Billion Mecha Empire), the overall quality of the items drawn this time was also shockingly high. He had obtained two Molding Talents, and even (Perfect Mechanical Sense) was obtained.

Thankfully, he had already obtained (Perfect Mechanical Sense) from bullying Nero. If he were to draw it again, it would only strengthen him slightly. Otherwise, he might really have trouble choosing.

The other three options were also very good. The Mechanic Emperor's Holy Trident was the weapon Manison used in battle. It was a Universal Treasure and was stronger than the Celestial Punishment Edge. [Blueprint-Felon] was a special living weapon modification technology that could even be used on Beyond Grade As. All the Beyond Grade As in Manison's' collection 'were probably modified this way.

[The Ancient Ones] was also a high-level talent. The Character Summon Card that Han Xiao had previously used was this ability. If he had not drawn [Billion Mechanic Empire], he might have chosen this ability to solidify into his own.

And these four abilities all paled in comparison to Manison's trump card. Han Xiao did not need to hesitate at all.

Tonight, we are all Manison!

You have received a new talent (Billion Mecha Empire — Manison)!

An indescribable change occurred in his body. It was different from the pain of a life evolution. Han Xiao only felt his body lighten up, as though he had broken some invisible shackles.

His line of sight rippled like water, and scenes flashed before his eyes at lightning speed.

A baby was born and quickly grew into a young man. The obscure mechanical theory books were like children's books, easily comprehending everything after flipping through them.

He saw the first Mechanical Force of the young man in the picture, the first book he read, the first machine he built, the first blueprint he improved, the first enemy he killed …

Then, the sun rose and the moon set. Countless messy and blurry pictures flashed by, and the person in the picture finally turned into an old man in a silver robe with electric sparks in his eyes. Behind him stood a vast mechanical army, which was boundless and filled every inch of space, occupying every inch of sight.

The illusion came to an abrupt end, and Han Xiao opened his eyes wide.

"This is old Manison growing up. I seem to have received a person's Unique Talent, and I can roughly see the other party's life … Heh, the other party is still alive and well. It's as if old Manison is dead."

This illusion was very blurry most of the time and lacked details. It only showed the more important points in Manison's life.

Han Xiao finished reading it, but of course, he did not gain any information. At most, he had a deeper understanding of Manison.

The pride of the heavens, brimming with talent, the most dazzling young man ever since he was young.

"A typical kid next door."

Han Xiao curled his lips.

The only special thing was that Manison had been so dazzling since he was young, and many things were within his reach. However, he did not seem to be interested in material comforts, nor did he like to mate. He only liked to stay in the workshop and work on machines.

This is a bit similar to me. We are both technicians who focus on craftsmanship …

Han Xiao shook his head and threw this illusion to the back of his mind. He carefully browsed through the effects of [Billion Mecha Empire — Manison]. Although the Unique Talent had been transferred to him, the suffix "Manison" had not disappeared, and it still indicated where it came from.

The most exaggerated bonus was the 5000% increase in production efficiency. This was probably part of the origin of Manison's "Mecha Empire" nickname. The speed at which he could produce troops was terrifying.

Although it was powerful, 50 times the production efficiency also meant 50 times the speed at which he burned money!

Manison had been working hard to expand his influence for many years. Apart from his ambition, it was probably also to support his expenses. With a large family and a large business, he could earn money and spend it quickly.

"The biggest difference between me and Manison is our foundation. With this bonus, the speed at which I accumulate my foundation will increase exponentially. Although it won't shorten the gap, I won't be left behind by him …" Han Xiao stroked his chin and thought to himself. "It's just that I'm spending money too quickly … Luckily, I'm not short of money."

The size of the Black Star Army was now enormous, and they were taking in a huge amount of cash every day. Furthermore, they had the Evolution Cube, which was a treasure trove. His family was wealthy enough that the word 'lack of money' was no longer in his dictionary.

The ability to create blueprints and research and development was also very strong, comparable to the effect of more than ten stacks of [Spirit Weapon]. The best was the 12% increase from the Gold blueprints. Manison was good at developing Universal Treasures, so he must have been affected by this talent.

"It should be much easier for me to research Universal Treasures in the future." Han Xiao was secretly happy.

As for the additional combat effects, it would be effective when dealing with machines. It was best at fighting among Mechanics, and it was also one of the reasons why Manison was so strong.

This way, the next time I go against the Mecha Empire, I'll be able to receive a targeted bonus.

"The bonus from the Mecha Empire is probably comparable to two Perfect Mechanical Senses. A top-grade Exclusive Talent is terrifying …"

Han Xiao was as satisfied as if he had eaten a good meal. This way, the gap between him and the Mecha Empire would be greatly reduced.

What I said before was right. Manison is indeed a good person.

Every time he turns hostile, he gives me a big gift. What kind of spirit is this? Repaying evil with good!

If not for the fact that he was afraid of angering Manison, he would have given Manison a banner with the words' Timely Galaxy Rain, Hero Manison 'written on it!

"Looks like I'll have to fight with the Mecha Empire more often in the future. Getting rich will all depend on him."

Han Xiao secretly rubbed his hands.

Closing the skill interface, he then looked at the other mission rewards.

The difficulty of Manison's direct challenge was extremely high, and the experience reward was even higher than the first time, close to a hundred billion. He had basically used all of his stock to exchange for Awakening Points, and now that he had replenished this round, his wallet was bulging again.

The rewarded Character Summon Card was an ability called [Energy Resonance]. Its effect was to reduce energy consumption and strengthen the attributes of his energy. When converted to Mechanical Force, it would increase the range of his Mechanical Force bonus. At the same time, as long as his energy did not reach zero, his energy bonus would always be at its peak.

Perhaps because he had used up all his luck when drawing the ability, the effect of the Character Summon Card was rather ordinary. He had the ability to exchange health and mana, so this Character Summon Card was rather useless.

However, Han Xiao was not discouraged. He was already very satisfied with obtaining Manison's core ability. Furthermore, this kind of result was the normal state of his luck. He was already used to it.

After calculating his gains, Han Xiao closed the interface and thought about the impact of this operation.

"I've changed the direction of the storyline. The virus core has been destroyed by me, and the Intelligent Plague can no longer sweep through the universe like in my previous life. The losses have been reduced by more than ninety-five percent. The explored universe survived this disaster without any danger, preserving more life force than in my previous life.

"With such a contribution, my Mission Rating should be at the highest level. Other than the Mission Rewards, the three Universal Civilizations will also express their gratitude. I can get a second wave of rewards, and when the news is released, I can get a third wave of rewards from the galactic society.

"It's a pity that I can't use it to deal with the World Tree after destroying the Domino Virus. However, I didn't use this virus in my previous life, so the impact shouldn't be too big. Speaking of which, if the World Tree cracked this technology and turned to deal with us, that would be quite bad. The negative impact of this virus on us is far greater than the World Tree. Eliminating this variable might not be a bad thing.

"The possibility of the Mecha Empire taking revenge on me is very low. After all, they have to deal with the suppression of the three Universal Civilizations, so they probably won't have the time to deal with me. Even if they really want to, I'm not that afraid of them now.

"Since the conflict has been made clear, the Mecha Empire and I will definitely fight in the association. Those Beyond Grade A Mechanics are not on the Mecha Empire's side, which means they're my hidden supporters. My right to speak in the development union should increase."

Han Xiao calculated in his mind and realized that he had actually gained quite a lot from this. The only downside was that he had offended Manison.

In his previous life, Manison had most likely gotten the virus core and was the biggest beneficiary of the Intelligent Plague.

Now, it was the other way around. In this operation, old Manison was the only one who suffered a loss.

"It seems like I've tricked him quite badly …"

Han Xiao scratched his head and shook off this thought.

"Pfft, what has it got to do with me? It's not that I'm bad, it's you who's too annoying."
